description: This bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 metric for four different approaches: “Ours”, “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”. The horizontal axis displays the category labels, arranged alphabetically, while the vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, labeled from 0.0 to 0.4 with a linear scale and tick marks at 0.1 intervals.  There are four individual bars, each a different shade of blue or orange. The “Ours” bar is orange and extends to approximately 0.33. The “- critiquing” bar is dark blue and reaches a value of approximately 0.29. The “- scoring” bar is a lighter blue and extends to approximately 0.22, while the “- ranking” bar is a slightly darker shade of blue and reaches approximately 0.20. No bars are visually emphasized, and there is no grouping or stacking of bars present.
